claim: As LLM capability scales up, calibration and failure prediction performance improve, but remain far from ideal.
falsifier: One can evaluate calibration (ECE) and failure prediction (AUROC) for a range of LLMs of varying scale on a fixed set of tasks and observe the trend.

conditions: across model families (GPT-3, Vicuna, GPT-3.5, GPT-4)
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported models and tasks; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Increase in model capability–improvement in calibration principle
